translations.Abdulbaki Gölpınarlı Meali: Rabbim dedi, beni yalanlamalarına karşı sen yardım et bana.

translations.M. Pickthall (English): He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me,
translations.Yusuf Ali (English): (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."(2898)
